## Regional & Topic Guides
### [Best Local Restaurants in Jackson, MS (Honest Guide)](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-restaurants-jackson-ms)
- **Summary**: For authentic, non-chain food in Jackson, Mississippi, start in the Fondren district with fall-apart brisket and green-chile mac & cheese at The Pig & Pint (3139 N State St) and a pimento cheeseburger with a hand-spun malt at Brent's Drugs (655 Duling Ave). Head downtown for dark-roux seafood gumbo and live blues at Hal & Mal's (200 S Commerce St), or take the family to The District at Eastover for brick-oven pizza and sundaes at Sal & Mookie's.
- **Q: What is the best BBQ restaurant in Jackson, Mississippi?** — The Pig & Pint at 3139 N State St in Jackson's Fondren neighborhood earned a 5.0/5 video review on The Local Guide MS for its knife-free tender smoked brisket, smoked chicken, fried green tomatoes, and green-chile mac & cheese.
- **Q: Where is the best neighborhood in Jackson, MS for local restaurants?** — Historic Fondren (along N State Street and Duling Avenue) offers the highest walkable concentration of local icons, anchored by The Pig & Pint and Brent's Drugs 1946 soda fountain.
- **Q: Where can I watch real POV video reviews of Jackson, MS restaurants?** — Watch unfiltered, self-paid Jackson and Central Mississippi food reviews with Damein & Mary on YouTube at @TheLocalGuide-MS and browse interactive maps at thelocalguidems.com.

### [Best Lunch & Local Eats in Pearl, Clinton & Madison, MS](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-lunch-pearl-clinton-madison-ms)
- **Summary**: Across Jackson's surrounding suburbs, the #1 weekday lunch value is the $12.50 Tuesday–Friday catfish lunch special (with 2 sides and crispy hushpuppies) at Moss Creek Fish House in Pearl (413 Riverwind Dr). In Clinton, hit ChopSticks Buffet (1012 Hampstead Blvd) for giant flaky fried fish fillets or Los Parrilleros (460 Springridge Rd) for sizzling fajitas under $40. North in Madison, Mama Hamil's (480 Magnolia St) is the benchmark southern BBQ and soul-food buffet.
- **Q: What is the best lunch special in Pearl, Mississippi?** — Moss Creek Fish House at 413 Riverwind Dr in Pearl runs a $12.50 weekday lunch special (Tuesday–Friday, 11 AM – 2 PM) with fried or grilled U.S. catfish, two sides like loaded baked potato or southern cabbage, and ultra-crispy hushpuppies.
- **Q: Where should I eat in Clinton, Mississippi?** — Top local picks in Clinton include ChopSticks Buffet on Hampstead Blvd (famous for massive, fluffy fried fish fillets and crisp egg rolls) and Los Parrilleros on Springridge Rd for huge sizzling fajitas under $40.
- **Q: Does The Local Guide MS post critical reviews too, or only 5-star reviews?** — Every meal is 100% self-funded and unfiltered — including our 1-star review of Takara Grill & Sushi on US-80 in Clinton where clean decor was overshadowed by severe wait times.

### [Best BBQ in Mississippi: Fondren, Delta & Coast Picks](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-bbq-in-mississippi)
- **Summary**: Mississippi BBQ spans three distinct regional styles: craft central-state smokehouse brisket and green-chile mac & cheese at The Pig & Pint in Jackson; century-old tangy pulled pork and corn-husk hot tamales at Abe's Bar-B-Q (est. 1924) in Clarksdale; championship pecan-smoked ribs on the bayou at The Shed in Ocean Springs; and all-you-can-eat southern ribs and fried chicken at Mama Hamil's in Madison.
- **Q: What is the oldest barbecue restaurant in Mississippi?** — Abe's Bar-B-Q at 616 N State St in Clarksdale has operated continuously since 1924 right at the Crossroads of Highways 61 and 49, serving pulled pork sandwiches and spicy Delta hot tamales.
- **Q: Where can I get pecan-smoked ribs on the Mississippi Gulf Coast?** — The Shed Barbeque & Blues Joint at 7501 MS-57 in Ocean Springs smokes award-winning spare and baby back ribs over pecan wood beside the bayou with live weekend blues.

## Detailed Establishment Dossiers (20 Locations)
### The Pig & Pint (Jackson, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/the-pig-and-pint-jackson-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8P_JgaugMtc
- **Address**: 3139 N State St, Jackson, MS 39216 | **Phone**: (601) 326-6070
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Closed Sun)
- **Official Website**: https://pigandpint.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://pigandpint.com/
- **Must-Order**: Fall-Apart Smoked Brisket, Green-Chile Mac & Cheese, Fried Green Tomatoes & House Sauces
- **What We Liked**: Brisket and smoked chicken were so tender they fell apart without needing a knife. The macaroni & cheese with mild chiles was the best restaurant mac & cheese Damein has had in a long time. Crispy fried green tomatoes and three distinct house-made sauces (Sweet Mississippi, Carolina Mustard, and Hot Red). Fast food runners, friendly table check-ins, and a lively indoor/patio atmosphere right in historic Fondren.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Menu FOMO is real — after seeing the BBQ nachos and brisket tacos pass by, Damein immediately wished we had ordered those to share too. Peak lunch and weekend evenings fill up fast along N State Street, so arrive a little early for prime parking.
- **Verdict**: Even walking in knowing The Pig & Pint had a big reputation in Jackson's Fondren district, this visit still blew us away. Both the sliced brisket and smoked chicken were juicy enough to pull apart with a fork, and the green-chile mac & cheese stood miles above standard cafeteria-style sides. Whether you lean toward their flagship Sweet Mississippi glaze, tangy Carolina mustard, or spicy red sauce, every plate comes out fast and hot.

### Moss Creek Fish House (Pearl, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/moss-creek-fish-house-pearl-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eGGlgI2LxI4
- **Address**: 413 Riverwind Dr, Pearl, MS 39208 | **Phone**: (601) 932-7424
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Tue - Sat: 11:00 AM - 8:30 PM (Closed Sun & Mon)
- **Official Website**: https://www.mosscreekfishhouse.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.mosscreekfishhouse.com/menu
- **Must-Order**: $12.50 Weekday Catfish Lunch Special, Crispy Hushpuppies, Loaded Baked Potato & Southern Cabbage
- **What We Liked**: Incredible $12.50 Tuesday–Friday lunch value including fried or grilled catfish plus two full sides and hushpuppies. Hushpuppies came out piping hot and ultra-crispy — easily among the best hushpuppies Damein has ever had. Generous, flaky golden catfish fillets and flavorful southern cooked cabbage. Warm, attentive hometown service (shoutout to our server Sam for making sure we didn't miss the cabbage!).
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: The $12.50 lunch special is only offered Tuesday through Friday (11:00 AM – 2:00 PM), and the restaurant is closed Sundays and Mondays. If you aren't a cooked-cabbage fan like Mary, definitely swap in the loaded baked potato or fried okra as your second side.
- **Verdict**: If you are anywhere near Pearl or I-20 on a weekday between 11 AM and 2 PM, Moss Creek Fish House's $12.50 catfish lunch special is tough to beat anywhere in the metro. The U.S. farm-raised catfish is light, flaky, and fried clean, the hushpuppies have an addictive crunch, and the staff treats you like regulars from the moment you sit down.

### ChopSticks Buffet (Clinton, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/chopsticks-buffet-clinton-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gp4klWno0lI
- **Address**: 1012 Hampstead Blvd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 924-2076
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Closed Mon)
- **Official Website**: https://chopsticksbuffetms.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://chopsticksbuffetms.com/
- **Must-Order**: Giant Light & Fluffy Fried Fish Fillets, Crispy Egg Rolls, Fried Wontons & Sweet and Sour Chicken
- **What We Liked**: The fried fish fillets were shockingly huge, light, and flaky — easily big enough for two people to split, unlike the thin fish at most buffets. Egg rolls and fried wontons were crisp, golden, and fresh off the line. Super welcoming staff who treat regulars like family every single visit. Convenient stop right off Hampstead Blvd and I-20 in Clinton with fair family pricing.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Closed on Mondays, so plan your Clinton lunch or dinner run Tuesday through Sunday. No active social media feeds — call ahead or check their website directly for holiday hours.
- **Verdict**: ChopSticks Buffet in Clinton holds a special spot for us as the very first restaurant filmed for The Local Guide MS, because it's a place Damein and Mary genuinely enjoy coming back to. Between the friendly faces at the counter, crisp wontons, and massive, fluffy fried fish fillets that put most buffets to shame, it delivers comfort and value every time.

### Mama Hamil's Southern Cookin' and BBQ (Madison, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mama-hamils-madison-ms
- **Address**: 480 Magnolia St, Madison, MS 39110 | **Phone**: (601) 856-4407
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat Lunch: 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM | Thu - Sat Dinner: 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.hamils.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.hamils.com/
- **Must-Order**: Smoked BBQ Ribs, Pulled Pork, Southern Fried Chicken, Mac & Cheese, Turnip Greens & Peach Cobbler
- **What We Liked**: True Mississippi meat-and-three soul food variety — smoked ribs, pulled pork, fried chicken, and chicken & dumplings under one roof. Scratch country vegetables (turnip greens, butter beans, mac & cheese) that taste like Sunday dinner at grandma's house. Warm peach cobbler and bread pudding included to finish the meal right. Spacious family dining room right off Magnolia Street in Madison with fast table service.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Come hungry and plan for a slower afternoon — it is almost impossible not to go back for seconds and cobbler. Dinner service runs select evenings (check Thursday–Saturday dinner schedule before driving up at night).
- **Verdict**: Documented with 22 dish and buffet photos on Damein's Google Maps profile, Mama Hamil's in Madison is the gold standard for homestyle Mississippi buffet cooking. Everything on the steam table tastes seasoned with care rather than mass-produced, making it a must-stop for families and road-trippers heading north on I-55.

### Los Parrilleros (Clinton, Mississippi) — 5.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/los-parrilleros-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 460 Springridge Rd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 488-4505
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Must-Order**: Sizzling Steak Fajitas, Creamy White Queso, Fresh Chips & Salsa
- **What We Liked**: Unbelievable value — we ordered full meals and appetizers and walked out with a total tab under $40. Huge portion sizes with tender, well-seasoned fajita steak arriving sizzling hot at the table. Fast, upbeat table service and endless crisp chips with fresh salsa.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: No official standalone website or online menu published yet — call (601) 488-4505 or stop in on Springridge Rd. Friday and Saturday dinner hours get lively and packed, so expect a short wait at peak times.
- **Verdict**: In an era where casual dinner for two routinely tops $65, Los Parrilleros on Springridge Road in Clinton blew us away by serving massive portions, hot skillet fajitas, and great service for under $40 total. It is one of the best everyday dinner values in Hinds County.

### Applebee's Grill + Bar (Clinton) (Clinton, Mississippi) — 4.2 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/applebees-clinton-ms-bourbon-street-chicken-penne
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2JXq8A6KS2I
- **Address**: 940 Hampstead Blvd, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 925-9515
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sun: 11:00 AM - 11:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://restaurants.applebees.com/en-us/ms/clinton/
- **Official Menu**: https://restaurants.applebees.com/en-us/ms/clinton/
- **Must-Order**: Bourbon Street Chicken & Andouille Sausage Penne
- **What We Liked**: Actual plate matched the menu photo surprisingly closely — plenty of sliced chicken and visible sausage on top. Chicken came out moist and tender rather than dried out under a heat lamp. The sliced andouille sausage had real smoky Cajun flavor that carried the pasta.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: As a national chain, you don't get the one-of-a-kind scratch character of local Clinton spots like ChopSticks or Los Parrilleros. Sauce richness can vary slightly depending on how busy the kitchen line is off I-20.
- **Verdict**: Part of being an honest local guide is testing everyday highway stops right alongside mom-and-pop legends. At the Clinton Hampstead Blvd location, the Bourbon Street Chicken & Andouille Penne genuinely held up to its menu photo with moist chicken and flavorful sausage.

### Takara Grill & Sushi (Clinton, Mississippi) — 1.0 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/takara-grill-and-sushi-clinton-ms
- **Address**: 951 US-80, Clinton, MS 39056 | **Phone**: (601) 924-8886
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sun: 11:00 AM - 2:30 PM, 4:30 PM - 9:30 PM
- **Must-Order**: Check Current Wait Times Before Seating (Hibachi & Sushi Rolls)
- **What We Liked**: The interior dining room is genuinely clean, spacious, and nicely decorated. Management publicly responded to Damein's Google review acknowledging the feedback and offering resolution.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Very slow service pacing and long wait times that derailed the dining experience during our visit. Table communication broke down when the dining room got backed up.
- **Verdict**: We include misses alongside our 5-star favorites because real trust requires honesty when a self-paid meal goes sideways. Takara Grill & Sushi on US-80 in Clinton has a beautiful, clean interior and an owner who took accountability in writing, so we hope to re-test their service on a future visit.

### Brent's Drugs & Soda Fountain (Jackson, Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/brents-drugs-jackson-ms
- **Address**: 655 Duling Ave, Jackson, MS 39216 | **Phone**: (601) 366-3427
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.brentsdrugs.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.brentsdrugs.com/menu
- **Must-Order**: Classic Pimento Cheeseburger, Crispy Griddle Burger & Hand-Spun Malt Shake
- **What We Liked**: Authentic teal vinyl booths and original 1946 brushed-chrome soda fountain counter right in Woodland Hills / Fondren. Griddle smash burgers have real crispy seared edges with scratch pimento cheese. Tucks The Apothecary speakeasy cocktail lounge right in the back for evening visitors.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Saturday brunch and lunch hours draw a crowd, so counter stools often open faster than four-top booths. Closed Sundays (check current daytime hours before planning a Sunday drive).
- **Verdict**: Brent's Drugs is one of Jackson's crown-jewel landmarks where the food genuinely lives up to the movie-set aesthetic. Pair a pimento cheeseburger here with dinner down the street at The Pig & Pint for the ultimate Fondren food day.

### Abe's Bar-B-Q (Clarksdale, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/abes-bar-b-q-clarksdale-ms
- **Address**: 616 N State St, Clarksdale, MS 38614 | **Phone**: (662) 624-9947
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 10:00 AM - 8:30 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.abesbbq.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.abesbbq.com/
- **Must-Order**: 'Big Abe' Pulled Pork Sandwich & Spicy Delta Hot Tamales
- **What We Liked**: Over 100 years of continuous family pit history right beside the famous Blues Crossroads guitar monument. Signature tangy, peppery sauce and slaw combination on the Big Abe pork sandwich. Authentic simmered cornmeal Delta hot tamales for an unbeatable budget price.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Old-school diner seating is simple and no-frills — you come here for history and smoke, not fancy decor. Popular items like rib tips and tamales can sell down late in the evening on festival weekends.
- **Verdict**: No Highway 61 Blues Trail road trip is complete without pulling over beneath the neon pig sign at Abe's Bar-B-Q in Clarksdale. Operating since 1924, it remains one of the most iconic culinary landmarks in the Mississippi Delta.

### The Shed Barbeque & Blues Joint (Ocean Springs, Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/the-shed-barbeque-ocean-springs-ms
- **Address**: 7501 MS-57, Ocean Springs, MS 39564 | **Phone**: (228) 875-9590
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Sun - Thu: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Fri - Sat: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.theshedbbq.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.theshedbbq.com/menu.html
- **Must-Order**: Pecan-Smoked Baby Back & Spare Ribs + Mac Daddy Mac & Cheese
- **What We Liked**: Grand-champion pecan-wood smoke flavor on the ribs with a caramelized bark that pulls cleanly off the bone. One-of-a-kind rustic tin-roof juke-joint atmosphere tucked right off I-10 Exit 57 on the bayou. Live Gulf Coast blues bands on weekends make dinner feel like a mini festival.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Counter lines stretch out the door on Friday and Saturday nights (though the line moves briskly). Mostly open-air / rustic porch seating, so dress for warm coastal breezes in summer.
- **Verdict**: Right off Highway 57 in Ocean Springs, The Shed Barbeque & Blues Joint turns a highway pit stop into a full Mississippi Gulf Coast memory. Between championship pecan-smoked ribs and live blues music on the bayou deck, it earns every bit of its acclaim.

### Hal & Mal's (Jackson, Mississippi) — 4.7 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/hal-and-mals-jackson-ms
- **Address**: 200 S Commerce St, Jackson, MS 39201 | **Phone**: (601) 948-0888
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sat: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://halandmals.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://halandmals.com/
- **Must-Order**: Dark-Roux Seafood Gumbo, Catfish Po'Boy & Red Beans
- **What We Liked**: Rich, deeply toasted Creole roux in the seafood gumbo packed with Gulf shrimp and sausage. Unmatched historic brick warehouse character in downtown Jackson near the Capitol and museums. Blue Monday blues jam and regular live concerts in the adjoining music hall.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Check event nights ahead of time — major concert evenings shift parking and bar wait times downtown. Closed Sundays and Mondays for standard lunch/dinner outside special events.
- **Verdict**: Founded by brothers Hal and Malcolm White in 1985, Hal & Mal's blends Louisiana-Mississippi Gulf flavors with downtown Jackson's live music heritage. Stop in for lunch after touring the Two Mississippi Museums or catch an evening blues set.

### City Grocery (Oxford, Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/city-grocery-oxford-ms
- **Address**: 152 Courthouse Square, Oxford, MS 38655 | **Phone**: (662) 232-8080
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat Lunch: 11:30 AM - 2:30 PM | Dinner: 5:30 PM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://citygroceryonline.com/restaurants/city-grocery/
- **Official Menu**: https://citygroceryonline.com/restaurants/city-grocery/
- **Must-Order**: Signature Shrimp & Grits with Smoky Bacon-Mushroom Jus
- **What We Liked**: The Shrimp & Grits genuinely lives up to its James Beard pedigree with deep smoky, savory balance. Historic exposed-brick building right on Courthouse Square with an iconic upstairs bar balcony. Lunch menu offers a much more approachable way to experience the kitchen without a formal dinner splurge.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Dinner reservations are essential — especially anywhere near an Ole Miss football or baseball weekend. Higher fine-dining price point at dinner compared to casual North MS stops.
- **Verdict**: Sitting directly on Oxford's historic Courthouse Square, City Grocery helped launch modern Southern dining onto the national stage while staying rooted in Mississippi ingredients. Pro tip: walk in for lunch or upstairs bar seating if dinner books out.

### Under-The-Hill Saloon & Riverfront (Natchez, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/under-the-hill-saloon-natchez-ms
- **Address**: 25 Silver St, Natchez, MS 39120 | **Phone**: (601) 446-8023
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Daily: 12:00 PM - Midnight
- **Must-Order**: Front-Porch Rocking Chair Sunset Over the Mississippi River
- **What We Liked**: One of the oldest surviving riverfront buildings on the lower Mississippi River, steeped in 1800s riverboat lore. Unbeatable west-facing sunset views right across the water toward Louisiana. Live acoustic and roots music on weekends with a laid-back, welcoming crowd.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Primarily a historic tavern rather than a full-service dinner kitchen — eat dinner atop the Natchez bluff before or after sunset. Steep drive down Silver Street to the river landing has limited narrow parking at golden hour.
- **Verdict**: At the southern terminus of the Natchez Trace Parkway, Silver Street dips below the bluffs to Under-The-Hill Saloon. Time your visit 45 minutes before sunset for one of the best scenic stops in the Deep South.

### Doe's Eat Place (Greenville, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/does-eat-place-greenville-ms
- **Address**: 502 Nelson St, Greenville, MS 38701 | **Phone**: (662) 334-3315
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM (Closed Sun)
- **Official Website**: https://doeseatplace.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://doeseatplace.com/
- **Must-Order**: 2-lb to 3-lb Broiled Porterhouse Steak, Delta Hot Tamales & Skillet Fries
- **What We Liked**: Unforgettable entrance right through the working kitchen past the steak broilers. Massive aged porterhouse, T-bone, and sirloin steaks broiled with butter and natural juices, ideal for splitting. Tender beef hot tamales and crisp skillet-fried potatoes that have stayed unchanged since 1941.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Steaks are priced by weight for sharing — ask your server about cut sizes up front so there is no bill surprise. Dinner-only hours (closed Sundays), and calling (662) 334-3315 ahead is strongly recommended.
- **Verdict**: While franchises exist in other states, nothing compares to the original 1941 Signa family building at 502 Nelson Street in Greenville. Zero pretension, mismatched tables, and some of the finest broiled beef in America.

### Mary Mahoney's Old French House (Biloxi, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mary-mahoneys-biloxi-ms
- **Address**: 110 Rue Magnolia, Biloxi, MS 39530 | **Phone**: (228) 374-0163
- **Price**: $$$ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM (Closed Sun)
- **Official Website**: https://www.marymahoneys.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.marymahoneys.com/lunch-menu/
- **Must-Order**: Half-Shell Seafood Gumbo, Lump Crab-Stuffed Flounder & Bread Pudding with Rum Sauce
- **What We Liked**: Stunning historic brick courtyard beneath one of the oldest live oak trees on the Gulf Coast. Generous sweet Gulf lump crabmeat and classic white-tablecloth coastal hospitality. Weekday lunch menu offers classic Biloxi seafood dishes at half the cost of evening entrées.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Dinner prices sit firmly in special-occasion territory — check the lunch menu if you want a lighter tab. Smart-casual dress and advance dinner reservations are wise on Gulf Coast weekends.
- **Verdict**: Just steps from Highway 90 and Biloxi's coastal resorts, Mary Mahoney's Old French House preserves nearly three centuries of Gulf Coast architecture alongside classic seafood recipes.

### Tishomingo State Park & Bear Creek (Tishomingo, Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/tishomingo-state-park-ms
- **Address**: 105 County Road 90, Tishomingo, MS 38873 | **Phone**: (662) 438-6914
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Daily: Sunrise - Sunset
- **Official Website**: https://www.mdwfp.com/
- **Must-Order**: Bear Creek Swinging Bridge Trail & Outcropping Rock Formations
- **What We Liked**: Towering Appalachian sandstone rock formations found nowhere else in Mississippi. Easy access right off the Natchez Trace Parkway (Milepost 304) with nominal day-use entry. 13 miles of shaded trails, disc golf, cabins, and seasonal Bear Creek canoe floats.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Limited food options directly inside the park — pack trail snacks and water before exiting the Trace. Sandstone steps near Bear Creek can get slick right after rain, so wear grippy shoes.
- **Verdict**: Located in the far northeast corner of Mississippi, Tishomingo State Park showcases Civilian Conservation Corps stonework, canyon bluffs, and one of the most photogenic swinging bridges in the South.

### Sal & Mookie's New York Pizza & Ice Cream (Jackson, Mississippi) — 4.7 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/sal-and-mookies-jackson-ms
- **Address**: 200 District Blvd E, Jackson, MS 39211 | **Phone**: (601) 368-1919
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Sun - Thu: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Fri - Sat: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://salandmookies.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://salandmookies.com/
- **Must-Order**: Southside Porker Specialty Pie & Mississippi Mudslide Sundae
- **What We Liked**: Clean, walkable location on The District green in Eastover with outdoor turf space for kids to play. Crisp, chewy New York deck-oven crust plus full-size ice cream parlor sundaes and shakes. Easy stop right off I-55 North in Jackson.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Weekend family dinner hours get loud and busy — grab a spot on the patio if you want a quieter meal. Specialty pies plus sundaes add up faster than a slice shop, though pies share well.
- **Verdict**: Created by Jackson chefs Jeff Good and Dan Blumenthal, Sal & Mookie's nails the rare combo of serious brick-oven pizza for adults and an old-fashioned scoop parlor for dessert.

### The Porter Public House (Hattiesburg, Mississippi) — 4.8 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/the-porter-public-house-hattiesburg-ms
- **Address**: 201 W Pine St, Hattiesburg, MS 39401 | **Phone**: (601) 336-9373
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Tue - Sat: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://www.theporterpub.com/
- **Official Menu**: https://www.theporterpub.com/menu
- **Must-Order**: Gourmet Pub Burger, Hand-Cut Fries & Rotating Mississippi Craft Taps
- **What We Liked**: Thoughtfully curated tap list highlighting Southern Prohibition and regional Mississippi breweries. Elevated scratch pub kitchen rather than frozen bar food, right across from the historic post office. Relaxed neighborhood pub vibe with outdoor seating.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Street parking around W Pine Street can tighten up during Downtown Hattiesburg art walks and trivia nights. Check current daytime vs. afternoon opening hours before a weekday stop.
- **Verdict**: When road-tripping down US-49 through the Pine Belt, The Porter Public House is one of Downtown Hattiesburg's best local hangouts for a burger and a pint brewed right down the street.

### Mississippi State Fairgrounds (Jackson, Mississippi) — 4.6 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mississippi-state-fairgrounds-jackson-ms
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z8W7oJ_NF7c
- **Address**: 1207 Mississippi St, Jackson, MS 39202 | **Phone**: (601) 961-4000
- **Price**: $$ | **Hours**: Annual Fair in October + Year-Round Coliseum & Trade Mart Events
- **Official Website**: https://visitmississippi.org/
- **Must-Order**: Fresh-Squeezed Fair Lemonade, Biscuit Booth Classics, Petting Zoo & Night Fireworks
- **What We Liked**: Nighttime midway lights and the fireworks finale over downtown Jackson were genuinely awesome. Cool surprise exhibits beyond rides — including touching a real meteorite and seeing classic boats & cars. Fun family livestock/petting area and non-stop energy.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Almost comedic wall-to-wall lemonade stands everywhere you turn, and fairground concessions add up fast. Evening weekend crowds require patience for parking and entry gates.
- **Verdict**: Every October, the Mississippi State Fairgrounds in downtown Jackson turns into a neon-lit tradition. Go right before dusk so you catch the exhibits and livestock barns before the midway lights and fireworks kick off.

### Bass Pro Shops at the Pyramid (I-55 Road Trip) (Memphis (North Border), Mississippi) — 4.9 / 5
- **Review URL**: https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/bass-pro-shops-pyramid-memphis-road-trip
- **YouTube Video Review (@TheLocalGuide-MS)**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tv0peH1ghtI
- **Address**: 1 Bass Pro Dr, Memphis, TN 38105 | **Phone**: (901) 291-8200
- **Price**: $ | **Hours**: Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Sun: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://stores.basspro.com/us/tn/memphis/1-bass-pro-dr.html
- **Official Menu**: https://big-cypress.com/
- **Must-Order**: Indoor Cypress Swamp Walk, Monster Live Catfish Lagoons & Live Alligator Habitat
- **What We Liked**: Free admission just to walk inside and explore the massive indoor Cypress Swamp, ponds, and aquarium tanks. Seeing giant live catfish and real alligators up close inside an arena-sized pyramid never gets old. Easy day trip straight up I-55 from Jackson, Granada, Batesville, Senatobia, or Hernando.
- **Honest Notes / Dislikes**: Riding the freestanding elevator to the top observation deck carries a separate ticket fee per person. Weekend afternoons draw massive tourist crowds around the bowling alley, restaurant, and elevator line.
- **Verdict**: Just minutes north of DeSoto County up I-55, the Bass Pro Pyramid is one of the wildest indoor roadside attractions in the Mid-South. Even if you aren't shopping for tackle, walking through the indoor Cypress Swamp to spot giant catfish and live gators is 100% worth the detour.
